entry.title: Serie G Special G
entry.summaryHtml: Toasted nuts, dry cedar, black coffee, light sweet spice and earth define the Cameroon-wrapped Special G. The Nicaraguan core gives the small perfecto enough body to avoid becoming thin, while the Cameroon leaf keeps the profile drier, nuttier and more aromatic than the Maduro. Its short shape concentrates the opening quickly before settling into coffee, cedar and toasted-nut notes.

note: Add the Natural/Cameroon counterpart to the existing Serie G Special G Maduro as a standalone entry. CigarWorld currently has the box of 48 available at A$1,292.10, or A$26.92 per cigar, the best verified Australian per-stick price found.
